title: Ali Ali Moula
body:
Ali maula, ali maula, ali maula
ali, ali, ali, ali, ali maula
<<MINI>>
ali ali, ali ali, ali ali, ali ali ali..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
man kunto maula, fa haza aliyun maula..(2)
ali ali maula, ali ali maula maula, ali ali maula, ali ali ali..(4)
1. Ishq e ali ke aaine mein
hum maulai sawarte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis o matam roza namaze
haider haider karte hai
khudkush hamle karne wale
maut haram ki marte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hum hai shaheedo'n ki auladein
dushman hum se darte hai
dil ki sada hai, ali ali maula
jaan fida hai, ali ali maula
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se likha
<<MINI>>
ali ali, ali ali, ali ali, ali ali ali
ali ali maula.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Naara e majlis, naara e mehfil
<<MINI>>

3. Qibla e awwal gunj raha hai
hizbullah ki jurrat se
takfiri sab toot rahe hai
ehle wigha ki haibat se
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala hai qarya, qarya
ehle azaa ki himmat se
lashkar e mahdi jeet raha hai
maula ali ki taaqat se
<<DIVIDER>>
ilm o ata hai, ali ali maula
ishq o wafa hai, ali ali maula
wajhe baqa hai
<<MINI>>
ali ali, ali ali, ali ali, ali ali ali
ali ali maula.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Haider hai tauheed ka suraj
chashme nabi ka tara hai
aisa namazi aisa mujahid
ye allah ka pyara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aai hai unneeswi shab to
behta khoon ka dhara hai
ghar mein khuda ke mehwe sajdah
rozedaar ko maara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shor bapa hai, ali ali maula
aaho buka hai, ali ali maula
khoon baha hai
<<MINI>>
ali ali, ali ali, ali ali, ali ali ali
ali ali maula.....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zehre halahal mein doobi
talwaar ki kaisi zarbat thi
maula ali ki reeshe mubarak
aaj lahu se surkh hui
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj yateem hai hone wali
girya kuna ye aale nabi
zainab se baate karti hai
aakhri hichki maula ki
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai khada hai, ali ali maula
shukre khuda hai, ali ali maula
sarpe rida hai
<<MINI>>
ali ali, ali ali, ali ali, ali ali ali
ali ali maula.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Roohe haider dekh rahi hai
kaisi musibat aai hai
laash e pisar par baap ki shafqat
ghutniyo chal kar pohchi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
fatahe khaiber ke bete ne
kitni taaqat mangi hai
seene se akbar ke sheh ne
kaise barchi khaichi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
teer laga hai, ali ali maula
zakhm khula hai, ali ali maula
dard bada hai
<<MINI>>
ali ali, ali ali, ali ali, ali ali ali
ali ali maula.....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jiska janaza shab mein utha tha
khoon ke aansu roti hai
maa aur beti dono ne
darbaar ki mushkil dekhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haath bandhe hai sar uryaa'n hai aur gale mein rassi hai
kufe mein be maqna o chadar
aaj ali ki beti hai
sabr o raza hai, ali ali maula
<<DIVIDER>>
sar bhi jhuka hai, ali ali maula
karb bada hai
<<MINI>>
ali ali, ali ali, ali ali, ali ali ali

<<DIVIDER>>
